383:t_1:3.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$　Briefing Room～

383:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's already been two weeks since we crossed to the $$中央大陸$$.」

383:t_1:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've won battle after battle... We've dealt a fair amount of damage to $$サイデリアル$$'s forces.」

383:t_1:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I thought $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ would keep hounding us, but he backed off surprisingly easily.」

383:t_1:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「He's had a string of failures too. He may have been relieved of duty.」

383:t_1:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll be facing $$サルディアス$$... and perhaps even $$バルビエル$$.」

383:t_1:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ appears, we'll have to prepare ourselves for the matter of Miss $$スズネ$$ too.」

383:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「That despicable man... Who knows what tactics he'll use...」

383:t_1:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「There's no point fearing uncertainties. Let us focus on the fighting on the $$中央大陸$$.」

383:t_1:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$セントラル・ベース$$ in the north of this continent has already fallen to $$ランド$$ and the others.」

383:t_1:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we strike the $$ターミナル・ベース$$s around the continent and take the $$セントラル・ベース$$ overseeing the south, $$サイデリアル$$ will have to withdraw.」

383:t_1:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our next target is particularly large. Taking that base will greatly affect the battles ahead.」

383:t_1:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「A $$ターミナル・ベース$$ inside a city... Its layout resembles $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$...」

383:t_1:16.en:
$$ブライト$$
「This operation will be a joint effort with the local resistance group.」

383:t_1:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「It will affect morale across the entire $$中央大陸$$. We must succeed.」

383:t_1:22.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「It's been a while, $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

383:t_1:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm glad to see you folks are doing well too.」

383:t_1:24.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「I never imagined you were part of the famous $c.」

383:t_1:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm happy we can fight alongside all of you again.」

383:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll take out the $$ターミナル・ベース$$'s main force. I'm counting on you to evacuate the residents.」

383:t_1:27.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Leave it to us. It'll be a huge help if you handle the front lines.」

383:t_1:28.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「After all, that base is practically holding the entire city hostage.」

383:t_1:29.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now that we're here, you can rest easy!」

383:t_1:30.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「There it is, the $$ヒートスマイル$$!」

383:t_1:31.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Oh, that reminds me... I've got a message for you.」

383:t_1:33.en:
$$メール$$
「You're getting too carried away, Darling!」

383:t_1:34.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Nope, it's from a man. He leads a resistance group far to the north of here.」

383:t_1:35.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「He's known as $$ブラック・サザンクロス$$... Do you know him?」

383:t_1:37.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...$n, aren't you going to talk to the resistance people?」

383:t_1:38.en:
$n
「No... They're friends of $$セツコ$$ and the others, but I've never met them before.」

383:t_1:39.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I see... I thought $n, that sweltering guy, the unlucky beauty and the guy in debt were all in the same group.」

383:t_1:41.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh, but... you're a little different, $n.」

383:t_1:42.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Because you're special to me, $n.」

383:t_1:48.en:
$n
(I really shouldn't ask about her family... Everyone has their own circumstances...)

383:t_1:49.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I don't like it when you start a conversation like that and then leave me hanging.」

383:t_1:51.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I'll ask you something hard to answer instead.」

383:t_1:53.en:
$n
「She's my partner. She was also my teacher when I went to school, so that's what I call her.」

383:t_1:54.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's not what I want to know. I'm asking what your relationship is, $n.」

383:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Our relationship...? We're partners in battle, and teacher and student the rest of the time...」

383:t_1:56.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I don't want to hear you dodge the question like that.」

383:t_1:58.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$$甲児$$, $$カレン$$, $$クルツ$$ and $$マオ$$ all told me to ask you for the rest...」

383:t_1:61.en:
$n
「...No, she isn't. Besides, there was someone else like that.」

383:t_1:62.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Where is that person now?」

383:t_1:64.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Did the relationship just fizzle out?」

383:t_1:66.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then maybe... I'll put myself forward to be your girlfriend, $n.」

383:t_1:68.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't look so surprised. ...Don't you think that would be fun?」

383:t_1:69.en:
$n
「...I'm sorry... I'm not in a position to think about that right now.」

383:t_1:71.en:
$n
「That's not it. ...Your cheerfulness has helped me, $$ティティ$$, and I'm grateful.」

383:t_1:72.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So you really... can't forget this Miss $$スズネ$$?」

383:t_1:73.en:
$n
「Forget her? Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't dead. I'll rescue her, no matter what.」

383:t_1:76.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Listen, $n... If I die, send me off into space...」

383:t_1:77.en:
$n
「Why are you saying that all of a sudden...!?」

383:t_1:78.en:
$$ティティ$$
「It isn't all of a sudden, is it? Not in times like these.」

383:t_1:79.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I'm... always thinking about what will happen after I die.」

383:t_1:81.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Promise me, $n. You turned me down, so at least do this one little thing for me.」

383:t_1:83.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Oh... I don't need comforting. I only said that thing about being your girlfriend on a whim. I wasn't serious at all.」

383:t_1:84.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do your best, $n. I'll be cheering you on as you try to bring Miss $$スズネ$$ back.」
